plugins.name: legit-pdf2md
plugins.description: v0.1.3 - Turn a PDF or Google Doc in your Drive into clean Markdown, and save it back to the same folder. PDFs are the most expensive thing you can hand an AI: every page is sent as a picture as well as text, so a 9-page guide can cost 17,600 tokens where the same words as Markdown cost 3,350. This converts it (scanned pages included, via Google's own OCR), strips the junk a Docs export leaves behind - base64 image blocks,  , letter-spaced text like 'S T A R T', stray asterisks - and checks the wording never changed. Works through a Composio Google Drive connection over MCP or the CLI; it detects which one you have. No connection? It still cleans a Markdown file you exported by hand.
